name: godel-loopholes-site
description: Public presentation of the godel-loopholes research. Renders from data/facts.json and the repository's markdown; holds no copy of any load-bearing value.

scripts.build: npm run verify:lockfile && npm run lint:facts && npm run lint:tokens && npm run check && astro build && npm run seal && npm run verify:csp
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run verify:browser && npm run verify:hero
scripts.verify:lockfile: npm ci --dry-run --os=linux --cpu=x64 >/dev/null && echo 'lockfile  resolves clean on linux-x64'
